domain_tools.description: Compare at most five catalog products with separate price units and optional dated membership

client-profile.description: Select the tenant-gated client profile (env: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE)

compact.description: Return only key fields (id, name, status, timestamps) for minimal token usage (default: false)

csv.description: Output as CSV (table and array responses) (default: false)

data-source.description: Data source for read commands: auto (live with local fallback), live (API only), local (synced data only) (default: auto)

human-friendly.description: Enable colored output and rich formatting (default: false)

max-age.description: Maximum acceptable age of local-store data before a stderr hint suggests sync; 0 disables (default: 30m0s)

no-input.description: Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents) (default: false)

no-learn.description: Disable the teach/recall learning loop for this invocation (default: false)

on.description: Requested Japan date YYYY-MM-DD; dated absence is not sold-out, closed or unavailable

plain.description: Output as plain tab-separated text (default: false)

quiet.description: Bare output, one value per line (default: false)

rate-limit.description: Max requests per second (0 to disable; default auto — pace to server rate-limit headers) (default: auto)

receipt.description: Write an atomic private run receipt (default: false)

region.description: Regional catalog: 10 せとうち, 20 北陸, 30 山陰, 40 九州; a public display preference (default: 10)

save.description: Save only returned normalized evidence locally; never purchases a ticket (default: false)

select.description: Comma-separated fields to include in output (e.g. --select id,name,price)

yes.description: Skip confirmation prompts (explicit confirmation for scripts) (default: false)
